The '''28th Producers Guild of America Awards''' (also known as '''2017 Producers Guild Awards'''), honoring the best [[Film producer|film]] and [[television producer]]s of 2016, were held at [[The Beverly Hilton]] in [[Beverly Hills, California]] on January 28, 2017.<ref>{{cite news|title=PGA Awards: The Complete Winners List|url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/lists/producers-guild-awards-2017-winners-list-full-966469|access-date=January 29, 2017|work=[[The Hollywood Reporter]]|date=January 28, 2017|language=en-US|archive-date=June 15, 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180615004817/https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/lists/producers-guild-awards-2017-winners-list-full-966469|url-status=live}}</ref> The nominations for documentary film were announced on November 22, 2016,<ref>{{cite news|last1=Brown|first1=Tracy|title='The Eagle Huntress,' 'O.J.: Made in America' among 2017 Producers Guild Award documentary nominees|url=http://www.latimes.com/entertainment/envelope/la-et-mn-pga-2017-documentary-awards-nominees-20161122-story.html|access-date=January 5, 2017|work=[[Los Angeles Times]]|date=November 22, 2016|language=en-US|archive-date=January 4, 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170104170542/http://www.latimes.com/entertainment/envelope/la-et-mn-pga-2017-documentary-awards-nominees-20161122-story.html|url-status=live}}</ref> the nominations for television were announced on January 5, 2017,<ref name=TVnoms>{{cite news|last1=McNary|first1=Dave|title=Producers Guild TV Awards: ‘Westworld,’ ‘Stranger Things,’ ‘Atlanta’ Grab Nominations|url=https://variety.com/2017/tv/news/westworld-stranger-things-producers-guild-award-tv-noms-1201953173/|access-date=January 5, 2017|work=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]]|date=January 5, 2017|archive-date=June 14, 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180614221252/https://variety.com/2017/tv/news/westworld-stranger-things-producers-guild-award-tv-noms-1201953173/|url-status=live}}</ref> and the nominations for film were announced on January 10, 2017.<ref>{{cite web|last1=Lewis|first1=Hilary|last2=Lee|first2=Ashley|title=2017 Producers Guild Film Nominations Revealed|url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/2017-pga-film-nominations-full-list-963101|work=The Hollywood Reporter|date=January 5, 2017|access-date=January 10, 2017|archive-date=June 14, 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190614074322/https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/lists/2017-pga-award-nominations-960097|url-status=live}}</ref>
